$comment: YuanCode MCP servers config. Place at ~/.yuancode/mcp.json (user-wide) or <project>/.yuancode/mcp.json (project-wide). Project entries win on collision with user entries. Each server is auto-detected as stdio (has `command`) or Streamable HTTP (has `url`).

echo.comment: Local stdio MCP server used by scripts/m6-smoke.mjs to verify the client end-to-end without external deps. Tools: mcp__echo__echo(message) and mcp__echo__add(a, b).

filesystem.comment: Official Anthropic filesystem MCP server. Read/write/list files inside the project root.

fetch.comment: Official Anthropic fetch MCP server. Lets the agent GET arbitrary URLs.

github.comment: Official GitHub MCP server. Requires $GITHUB_TOKEN env var to be set.

remoteExample.comment: Example remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP (OAuth bearer).
